<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

use MeroDiet\Repositories\ClientRepository;
use MeroDiet\Repositories\CustomFoodRepository;
use MeroDiet\Repositories\PlanRepository;
use MeroDiet\Repositories\RecipeRepository;

$practitioner = 1;
$clients      = new ClientRepository();
$foods        = new CustomFoodRepository();
$recipes      = new RecipeRepository();
$plans        = new PlanRepository();

foreach ( array(
	array( 'Priya', 'Thapa', 'Lose 6 kg with a steady routine', 'Vegetarian', array( 'peanuts' ) ),
	array( 'Rohan', 'Karki', 'Gain lean muscle, 2,800 kcal target', '', array() ),
	array( 'Sita', 'Gurung', 'Manage blood sugar with balanced meals', 'Low sugar', array( 'shellfish' ) ),
	array( 'Arjun', 'Shrestha', 'Marathon prep: carb periodisation', '', array() ),
) as $c ) {
	$clients->create( $practitioner, array(
		'first_name'           => $c[0],
		'last_name'            => $c[1],
		'email'                => strtolower( $c[0] ) . '@example.test',
		'goals'                => $c[2],
		'dietary_restrictions' => $c[3],
		'allergies'            => $c[4],
	) );
}

$f = array();
foreach ( array(
	'Rolled oats'          => array( 379, 13.2, 67.7, 6.5 ),
	'Greek yogurt'         => array( 59, 10.2, 3.6, 0.4 ),
	'Blueberries'          => array( 57, 0.7, 14.5, 0.3 ),
	'Chicken breast'       => array( 165, 31, 0, 3.6 ),
	'Brown rice, cooked'   => array( 123, 2.7, 25.6, 1 ),
	'Broccoli'             => array( 34, 2.8, 6.6, 0.4 ),
) as $name => $v ) {
	$f[ $name ] = $foods->create( $practitioner, array(
		'name' => $name, 'calories' => $v[0], 'protein' => $v[1], 'carbs' => $v[2], 'fat' => $v[3],
	) );
}

$bowl = $recipes->create( $practitioner, array(
	'name'        => 'Lemon herb chicken bowl',
	'description' => 'Grilled chicken over brown rice with steamed broccoli.',
	'servings'    => 1,
	'items'       => array(
		array( 'food_id' => $f['Chicken breast'], 'quantity_grams' => 150.0 ),
		array( 'food_id' => $f['Brown rice, cooked'], 'quantity_grams' => 150.0 ),
		array( 'food_id' => $f['Broccoli'], 'quantity_grams' => 100.0 ),
	),
) );

$days = array();
for ( $i = 0; $i < 3; $i++ ) {
	$days[] = array(
		'day_offset' => $i,
		'items'      => array(
			array( 'meal_type' => 'breakfast', 'food_id' => $f['Rolled oats'], 'quantity_grams' => 60.0 ),
			array( 'meal_type' => 'breakfast', 'food_id' => $f['Greek yogurt'], 'quantity_grams' => 150.0 ),
			array( 'meal_type' => 'lunch', 'recipe_id' => $bowl, 'servings' => 1.0 ),
		),
	);
}
$plans->create( $practitioner, array(
	'title'      => 'Balanced starter plan',
	'start_date' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d' ),
	'end_date'   => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+2 days' ) ),
	'days'       => $days,
) );
